sampling: daily at 12:00 UTC, identical every year

record_window.means: every record claim in this file is scoped to 1940-2026 and must be stated that way. ERA5 itself begins in 1940; saying 'the ERA5 record' while computing a shorter window overclaims by the difference. Never 'warmest ever'.

august.caution: the margin over second place is small. A different SST product could reorder the top two. The anomaly is the robust figure; the ranking is not.

cut_to_same_date.means: every August mean in this file counts the SAME calendar days, 1 August to the last day 2026 has. NOT comparable to a figure cut at a different day. Late August cools, so a longer window for other years understates them against a short window for 2026.

largest_anomaly_day.means: the day in 2026 when the sea was furthest above its own normal, which is not the day it was warmest
